 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Indispensible"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is*** "Indispensable".*** (अनिवार्य)

 
 
• **Example: **Good health is **indispensable **for a happy life.
 
 
 
• **"Indispensable"** means absolutely **necessary, essential, or requisite**. (अनिवार्य)
 
 
• **Example: **An experienced guide is** indispensable** for a successful trek in the mountains.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **'indispensable.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Paraphernalia **(सामान): Miscellaneous articles, especially the equipment needed for a particular activity.

 
 
• **Example:** He carried all his fishing** paraphernalia** to the lake.
 
 
 
• **Handkerchiefs **(रूमाल): A piece of cloth used for wiping the face or hands, or blowing the nose.
 
 
• **Example: **She always keeps a **handkerchief** in her bag.
 
 
 
• **Conjuror** (जादूगर): A person who performs magic tricks.
 
 
• **Example:** The** conjuror** amazed the children with his magic tricks.
